name: notes-meeting-decision
description: A question about a recorded meeting, answered from its transcript: which venue was picked and for when.

transcript.text: So where are we on the venue for the launch party?
I looked at three places. The Hilltop Barn is twelve hundred pounds for the evening and fits eighty people.
The Old Mill is cheaper, but it only fits forty.
Eighty is what we need, so let's go with the Hilltop Barn.
Great. I'll book the Hilltop Barn for Friday the 21st and send the deposit this week.

turns.user: Which venue did Dave and I pick for the launch party, and when is it booked for?
